summary: Cred and Duck discuss Bitcoin struggling at 59-60k support after months of consolidation near all-time highs. They note the weekly chart is technically bearish but sentiment has improved significantly after the washout to 49k. ETH is viewed more favorably with the ETF catalyst and first test of 2500 support. Solana is concerning with range support at 125-135 being tested 5 times. US politics significantly impacting crypto with the industry over-indexed on Trump, creating downside risk if Democrats win. Altcoins broadly suffering with 50-90% drawdowns against BTC, and infrastructure tokens like LINK, LDO, ARB struggling despite protocol utility.
key_takeaways: BTC at 59-60k support is exhausted after months of testing, but 47k monthly support provides backstop. Shorting here has poor risk/reward with limited downside to 40-44k
ETH looks attractive as bullish bet: first test of weekly support at 2500, ETF catalyst, sentiment washout complete. New ATH expected if 3k reclaims
Solana 125-135 range support tested 5 times is concerning - Duck bearish, expects 70 if 100 breaks
Crypto industry over-indexed on Trump, creating political risk. If Democrats win, expect months of bad price action but not catastrophic
Altcoins experiencing brutal dispersion of returns - wrong picks or timing means zero gains in bull market. LINK down 89% vs BTC, LDO down 42% YTD
